digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira adapter mapping seam
propositions: rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py, preventing support for projects with non-standard states, types, transitions, or parent relationships without core edits

mapping seam must be provider-neutral and config-driven via rebar.toml with layered precedence (built-in default → config default block → per-project overlay) supporting status, type, link relations, priority, transitions, and parent relationships

type mappings lacking target analogue must support collapse (with rebar-type: label round-trip safety), skip (whole-ticket exclusion), or drift (with warning); unmapped non-skipped types must fail closed at config load

non-allowed transitions must be replayed via the core per-ticket STATUS event log to re-attempt recorded hops in order; if no recorded trail survives (e.g. compacted tickets) or replay fails, transition drifts without restricting rebar's local transitions
non-representable parent relationships must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key

rebar bridge suggest-mapping command must interrogate live target and emit suggested config for every offline-discoverable axis; rebar doctor must detect offline-invalid config and live drift against target
